_doc: Quality gate thresholds for data_quality tests. Each metric has 'fail' (hard gate, test FAILS) and 'warn' (diagnostic, printed as warning) levels. Adjust these when retraining models or changing the adjustment chain — they are the single source of truth for quality expectations.
_baseline_note: Baseline values from CLAUDE.md: ECE=0.1116, Pearson r=0.44, Compass bias large, ECE amplification 4.3x. Fail thresholds are set to catch catastrophic degradation while allowing normal variance.

calibration._description: End-to-end calibration quality on stratified sample from cases.feather

per_segment_brier_ratio_max._doc: max(segment_brier) / overall_brier — catches stratified miscalibration like C9 underestimated 18pp

adjustment_chain._description: How much the adjustment chain amplifies calibration error vs base model

blind_eval._description: AI expert blind evaluation vs model prediction agreement

pearson_r._current_note: 2026-08-11 盲评 n=37 有效对比（第二次重跑）

spearman_r._current_note: 2026-08-11 盲评 n=37 有效对比（第二次重跑）

mae._current_note: 2026-08-11 盲评 n=37 有效对比（第二次重跑）

ai_low_confidence_min_rate._doc: If 0/N are low confidence, LLM is overconfident (known issue). If >80% low, model may be broken. Set to non-null to gate.

external_data._description: Held-out evaluation on external datasets (Compass all-positive, ApplySquare mixed)

compass_mean_prob_min._doc: All-positive data should have non-trivial mean probability

applysquare_brier_max._doc: Brier score on ApplySquare filtered sample. Known data quality issues (high missing rate) → threshold relaxed vs training data. _current ~0.56 from 2026-06 audit.

applysquare_bias_pp_max._doc: |mean_prob - mean_actual| on ApplySquare. Known -67pp bias from CLAUDE.md — this gate monitors for further worsening beyond the documented baseline.

sparsity_stress._description: Prediction quality on sparse (≤4 sample) combinations

anomaly_rate_max._doc: Fraction of sparse predictions flagged as anomalous

prediction_failure_rate_max._doc: Fraction of sparse predictions that fail entirely

prediction_rigor._description: Loose thresholds tightened from original values — these are hard-coded in test_prediction_rigor.py directly
prediction_rigor._note: Only documented here for visibility; actual values live in the test file
